description: Search Skillselion, a curated directory of Claude Code agent skills, MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, ranked by real community signal (installs + GitHub stars). Use to browse trusted skills/MCPs/marketplaces for the task at hand (e.g. "postgres", "code review", "playwright"). Skill searches blend keyword + semantic ranking (same matcher as load_skill). To actually USE a skill, call load_skill (with an id from here, or directly with a query - it searches for you).

context.description: Optional: your stack + constraints (e.g. "Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, no new deps"). Used for RANKING only, never for keyword matching - so versions, years and situational detail belong here, not in `query`.

query.description: The task or domain in plain words - 2-6 words, ONE topic (e.g. "postgres row level security", "react component testing", "stripe webhooks"). The catalog matches EVERY word, so extra words return WORSE results, not more: no keyword soup, no synonym lists, no years or version numbers (those go in `context`). If the results look wrong, retry with FEWER words - never more.

type.description: Restrict to one listing type. Omit to search all.

name: search_skillselion
